description: Place 1 through k exactly once in a k-by-k matrix, filling other cells with zero. Row and column conditions require strictly earlier rows or columns. Return [] if impossible.
intuition: Topologically sort row conditions and column conditions separately. A cycle in either makes the task impossible. Otherwise place each number at its position in the two orders.
